verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents official SDKs/quickstarts for multiple languages (Python, JavaScript, C#, Go, Node.js starter repo) plus a browser Agent SDK, and confirms an OpenAPI spec is available for programmatic/agentic use. This directly supports building against official SDKs for the Voice Agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and completeness beyond first-party docs.
